jtheoof pacman repository

Personal Arch Linux packages, built and signed by GitHub Actions from jtheoof/PKGBUILDs. x86_64 only.

1. Trust the signing key

Check the fingerprint below against another source (the repository README) before trusting it.

curl -fsSL https://pkg.jtheoof.me/jtheoof.gpg | sudo pacman-key --add -
sudo pacman-key --lsign-key F44D05A50F6C9EB5C81BCF966A6B35DBE9442683

Fingerprint: F44D 05A5 0F6C 9EB5 C81B CF96 6A6B 35DB E944 2683

2. Add the repository

Append to /etc/pacman.conf:

[jtheoof]
SigLevel = Required DatabaseRequired
Server = https://pkg.jtheoof.me/$arch

Then sudo pacman -Sy and install what you want.
